openQuestions: Official name in English and Ukrainian, canonical domain and postal address, from the official site and the EDEBO register.
Dated official statement for the current academic year on whether, where and how foreign students are taught.
State registration (EDEBO), programme licence (Ministry or EDEBO licence register) and NAQA accreditation for each health programme: three separate claims.
Which medicine, dentistry, pharmacy or nursing programmes admit foreign applicants, in which language, with what duration and intake, and the official fee page.
Location lead as found (unverified): Lutsk (lead: Луцьк, вул. Лесі Українки, 2 — education.ua/universities/978)

Relocation lead (unverified): No relocation lead. Lutsk (Volyn oblast, western Ukraine) is neither occupied nor front-line. Address lead: вул. Лесі Українки, 2, Луцьк (education.ua, undated). Activity leads for the 2026/27 cycle (master's intake 7–22 Aug 2026, college intake 12–17 Aug 2026) and an acting rector ("В.о. ректора — Пастрик Тетяна Володимирівна", education.ua) indicate a functioning institution. No merger, suspension or licence-revocation lead was found in a targeted search (реорганізація / ліцензія / акредитація 2025).

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Name confusion: an English search for "Volyn Medical Institute" Lutsk returned ONLY Lesya Ukrainka Volyn National University (VNU) pages; VNU's medical unit was itself named "Educational and Scientific Medical Institute" in 2020–2021 (inventory block for lesya-ukrainka-volyn-national-university). The two are distinct legal entities (communal institute at вул. Лесі Українки 2 vs state university at просп. Волі 13), but a directory card titled "Volyn Medical Institute" invites conflation.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Relevance: nursing-level institute (223 Медсестринство bachelor/master, 053 psychology, plus a vocational college). No medicine, dentistry or pharmacy degree lead. No lead of any kind for admission of foreign citizens or English-medium teaching; the inventory flag "domestic intake" stands unchanged.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Ownership discrepancy in aggregators: osvita.ua lists "Форма власності: Державна" while the legal name and education.ua say Волинської обласної ради (communal). Probably stale catalogue data, unverified.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Fee figures differ between aggregator pages (28,300 UAH for 2025 vs 36,600 UAH bachelor / 45,850 UAH master for 2026); none read from the official page. Do not present either as current.

Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: The structural unit Луцький базовий фаховий медичний коледж (фаховий коледж, professional junior bachelor level) appears on separate aggregator pages (education.ua/colleges/1998, vstup.osvita.ua r4/7042) and could be mistaken for a separate institution or for higher-education programmes ("Стоматологія ортопедична", "Лікувальна справа" are college-level, not dentistry/medicine degrees).
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: Leadership listed as acting rector ("В.о. ректора") on education.ua — governance status unverified.
Red flag to resolve before any fact is shown: No official English name, English site version or international page surfaced; "Volyn Medical Institute" is a translation.

Missing evidence: No official page read: vmi.volyn.ua (and www.vmi.volyn.ua) could not be opened; everything above is a search-result lead. Needed: the institute's own 'Правила прийому 2026' (incl. any section on іноземці), the 'Перелік спеціальностей' and licence/fees pages, and the history page (foundation year, former names).
Missing evidence: EDEBO registry entry (registry.edbo.gov.ua): legal name, ЄДРПОУ code, ownership form, licensed specialties (223, 053) and licence volumes — not found in search.

Missing evidence: MON licence order for the second (master's) level in 223 Медсестринство and any NAQA accreditation decisions/certificates for the bachelor and master programmes — asserted only on institute material; the self-assessment PDF's programme and year are unknown.
Missing evidence: Whether foreign citizens are admitted at all, under what conditions, and whether any teaching is in English — no lead in any direction.
Missing evidence: Official English name and whether the site has an English version or an international applicants page — not found.
Missing evidence: Current tuition fees from the official page (aggregators show 28,300 / 36,600 / 45,850 UAH for different years and levels).
Missing evidence: Rector / acting rector confirmation (education.ua lists Пастрик Тетяна Володимирівна as в.о. ректора).
Missing evidence: Ownership confirmation: communal (Volyn Regional Council) per legal name vs 'Державна' per osvita.ua.
Missing evidence: Relationship and dates for the structural unit Луцький базовий фаховий медичний коледж (search summary mentioned a host lbmk.lutsk.ua — unverified, not seen in any result URL).
Missing evidence: Level of the 'Екстрена медицина/парамедик' programme (bachelor per search summary only).

Missing evidence: Note on domain: vmi.volyn.ua returned institutional pages and PDFs in two searches and both search summaries name it as the institute's site, but it is not confirmed by any government register — hence domainConfidence medium.

Skeptic's note: Name-confusion risk: an English search for 'Volyn Medical Institute' Lutsk returned only Lesya Ukrainka Volyn National University (candidate), whose medical unit was itself called 'Educational and Scientific Medical Institute' in 2020-2021. The two are distinct legal entities (communal institute at вул. Лесі Українки 2 vs state university at просп. Волі 13); the profile must say so.

Skeptic's note: No EDEBO, MON licence register, Study in Ukraine or NAQA entry surfaced; the master's licence in 223 Медсестринство is asserted only on the institute's own pages. Open question, not a bar.

Skeptic's note: Qualifying degree leads are nursing only (bachelor «Сестринська справа», «Екстрена медицина/парамедик»; master «Сестринська справа»). No medicine, dentistry or pharmacy degree lead; the structural unit Луцький базовий фаховий медичний коледж offers only vocational programmes («Стоматологія ортопедична», «Лікувальна справа») that must not be shown as degrees.
Skeptic's note: Ownership discrepancy (communal per legal name and education.ua vs 'Державна' on osvita.ua); acting rector only (В.о. ректора) per education.ua.
